item.title: Middle East Eye: Iran says oil tanker on fire after striking a mine near Hormuz
item.description: Iran says oil tanker on fire after striking a mine near Hormuz Iranian media reported on Sunday that an oil tanker has caught fire after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz. According to the Iranian navy, the oil tanker turned off its identification systems and was travelling in the no-go zone in the strategic waterway.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Iran condemns ‘Saudi aggression’ after dozens killed in attack on Taiz market
item.description: Iran condemns ‘Saudi aggression’ after dozens killed in attack on Taiz market Iran condemned “Saudi aggression” in Yemen on Sunday after an air strike on a market in Taiz killed dozens of civilians. In a statement posted on X, Iran's foreign ministry called for “an immediate halt to military attacks, a complete end to the blockade and respect for the Yemeni people’s right to self-determination”. Both the Houthis and Yemen’s Saudi-backed government have blamed each other for the attack.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israel kills two Palestinians in attack on Gaza's Khan Younis
item.description: Israel kills two Palestinians in attack on Gaza's Khan Younis Israeli bombardment of southern Gaza's Khan Younis city has killed two people, including a woman, Wafa reports citing a medical source. According to the source, the attack struck a group of civilians near the Taiba Towers, in the city's west, resulting in the two fatalaties and several other casualties.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's King Khalad airport
item.description: Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's King Khalad airport The Houthis have claimed an attack on the King Khalid International Airport and Saudi Aramco oil storage tanks. The latest alleged attacks follow a previous strike on the kingdom's financial centre in Riyadh, also claimed by the Houthis, that eyewitnesses said caused damage to a skyscraper belonging to oil giant Aramco.

item.description: Palestinian journalist and activist freed from Israeli police custody after five-day detention The Palestinian journalist and activist Abed Abu Shehadeh has been freed following five days in Israeli police custody.
